description: Max raw bytes of the frontend entry chunk (the JS file dist/index.html loads first). Measured 1277527 bytes on 2026-10-11 (1.28 MB); set 1% plus rounding above. Ratchet down with `bun scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs --ratchet` whenever the chunk shrinks (e.g. after the code split in PR #161). Raise only with a reason in the PR.
